page.content:
Lucy is a character created by author Ian Davey as one of the protagonists in his Bh'yhlun series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. She made her first appearance in 1997 in "Black Letter Day".

page.overview:
Who is Lucy?

Lucy is a character created by author Ian Davey as one of the protagonists in his Bh'yhlun series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. She made her first appearance in 1997 in "Black Letter Day".

Lucy was, in the time before the coming of Nyarlathotep, a regular woman in a relationship with a man named Georgio, a gifted filmmaker. Georgio decided to create a piece based on an old book he had come across, Feery's Notes on the Necronomicon, and thus began the end of the human race, an event which Lucy was uniquely placed to witness.

After the fall of humankind Lucy, alone and pregnant, preserved her sanity through the careful use of certain drugs while she made her way to Glastonbury, following a psychic pull which promised safety.

Eventually reaching Glastonbury, Lucy, a girl who called herself Glyph, and older couple Helen and Aaron defeated an avatar for Nyarlathotep and managed to restore the world to its former condition- mostly…
